summary: Focused UI testing of the new Loan Underwriting Pre-Screening Checklist feature as directed. Backend prescreen routes were already verified by main agent via curl; this iteration exercised the Admin Readiness console UI, client bulk/unassigned upload, no-track client state, and partner/client/admin login routing regressions. Everything requested works. Site is left UNLOCKED (verified /api/site/status => {"locked": false}).
action_items: DOC/SPEC NIT (not a bug): the review request says '14 common + 9 pre-revenue' and '14 common + 13 operating', but prescreen_checklist.py actually has 8 required pre-revenue items (specs_boq is required=False) and 12 required operating items (sales_ledgers is required=False). Observed required_total = 22 (pre-revenue) and 26 (operating). This matches the data file and the main-agent-verified 26 for operating. Either update the spec text or flip specs_boq / sales_ledgers to required=True — functionally fine either way.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminReadiness.jsx NEXT map cycles missing->verified->rejected->received->verified. Spec expected missing->verified->rejected->received, but the current mapping yields the same four states (just offset) and persists correctly, so acceptable. Only call-out: 'missing' and 'received' both map to 'verified' — a brand-new file can never cycle through 'received' from the admin button; it jumps straight to verified. Minor UX divergence from the stated contract.

ReadinessTab.jsx bulk-upload input is nested inside the <label data-testid='bulk-upload'>, so programmatic set_input_files on 'bulk-upload-input' works but the label area is the actual click target. OK as-is.
server.py _maybe_notify_ready guards against double-send with a persisted flag in db.prescreen (notified_ready_at) — confirmed by main agent that the email fires exactly once.

prescreen_checklist.red_flags on the 'pre_revenue' track adds 5 extra flags, so a fresh no-track client sees 2 gates (equity + coverage, both 'unknown') until the admin assigns a track — matches the observed UI (2 gates outstanding on the no-track account).
